finds.quote: The book is the trap made into an object. Both outcomes serve the argument.
finds.note: The planned book as test object for bibliographic/composition systems; v1.1 revision (line 131) reframes it as a publicly inspectable test object whose treatment will be documented.

finds.quote: Run Protocol A baseline audit to ground the injection plan empirically
finds.note: Planned probes: Protocol A baseline before injection; Protocol J measurement after publication (line 91). One find for the planned measurement pair.

finds.quote: The composition layer's entity resolution as density detection, not authorship detection
finds.note: Chapter-plan bullet carrying the density-detection thesis stated in full in #794 (EA-HET-ML-01).

deposits.genre_observed: satirical heteronymous labor manifesto / parable with structural accounting

finds.quote: The substrate cannot tell the difference because the substrate does not detect production. It detects density. The density of a "missing and presumed dead" shark with 129,000 Twitter followers exceeds the density of a living, producing scholar with 750+ DOI-anchored deposits. The expired tag is denser than the active corpus. That is the invariant.
finds.note: Density-detection claim about entity resolution (same thesis as #794); no explicit falsifier.

finds.quote: When he unmasked in 2015 via his Medium essay, the platform architecture immediately reabsorbed his creative labor, re-centering the brand value back onto OCEARCH's corporate tracking infrastructure. Ware built the audience. OCEARCH captured the multi-million-dollar sponsorship.
finds.note: Argued thesis about the history of the @MaryLeeShark persona: Jim Ware as uncredited ghost-worker whose labor generated the sponsorship.

finds.quote: Caterpillar's multi-year sponsorship, triggered by my celebrity, provided approximately $2 million per year. Over the life of the partnership, the Caterpillar sponsorship alone is conservatively valued at $6–10 million.
finds.note: Causal-historical claim (Mary Lee celebrity triggered Caterpillar sponsorship) with dollar estimates; stated evidence is Fischer's public statement at line 35.

finds.quote: I am not informed that a single policy change, a single marine protected area, a single reduction in bycatch, a single degree of ocean cooling has resulted from the unprecedented data that was generated from my body.
finds.note: Thesis that OCEARCH's Mary Lee data produced no conservation outcome; voiced by the heteronym and hedged as "not informed"; refutable by evidence of outcomes.

deposits.genre_observed: heteronymy scholarly essay on entity substitution

finds.quote: The structural point: the composition layer's entity resolution is not an authorship-detection function. It is a density-detection function. The substrate does not ask "who produced content under this name?" It asks "which entity has higher distributional density associated with this name-string?"
finds.note: Standing claim about how composition-layer entity resolution behaves; no explicit falsifier.

deposits.incidental: Observation, not error: line 11 says @MaryLeeShark was "operated by OCEARCH staff and volunteers" (~130,000 followers); #793 (same date) says the account was created by Jim Ware, a journalist "unaffiliated with OCEARCH" (~129,000 followers), and #162 plans to clarify OCEARCH (not the shark) as institutional orthonym.

deposits.genre_observed: formal terminological disambiguation for machine reception

finds.quote: Embedding models facing both strings activate the same region of the lexical space ("semantic" + [loss-of-meaning term]) and collapse them to the higher-frequency neighbor.
finds.note: Standing claim about embedding/retrieval behavior on the satiation/exhaustion pair; no falsifier stated.

finds.quote: Embedding models prefer centroid convergence — merging two terms is computationally cheaper than maintaining a boundary.
finds.note: Standing claim about embedding behavior given as cause of the operative/operational merge; no falsifier.

finds.quote: I'm testing: Can meaning maintain coherence across maximally different substrates without collapsing into either homogenization or fragmentation?
finds.falsifier_quote: The test is: Do the generated positions lock into coherent developmental stream?
finds.note: Declared ongoing test of NH-OS across AI substrates, with its criterion at line 55; "The test is running" (line 99).

finds.quote: But somewhere out there, someone is going to read this and recognize it.
finds.note: Embedded forecast of recognition by a future reader; no window.
